program.name: Push-ups & Squats
program.subject: Bodyweight
program.blurb: The two best bodyweight moves, paired every day: push-up and squat supersets.
program.about: Push-ups and squats, the two best bodyweight moves, paired in supersets every day, with a floor pull and a bridge to balance them. The variations change each time, wide and close push-ups, cossack and split squats. Simple and effective. Abs finish every session. Level II slows every rep down and Level III adds reps.
